utility.notes: The City of Fullerton's own Utility Services Division page describes that division's scope as water, sanitation, sewer, and trash billing only, with no electric utility function, and the city's own Energy Conservation page promotes SCE's CARE & FERA discount programs to residents — both consistent with SCE (not the city) being the electric utility. Fullerton's site also has a page titled 'Public Utilities Commission,' a naming trap verified separately to cover only water/sanitation/sewer/trash, not electric.

value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program

value.notes: Fullerton Municipal Code Chapter 14.18 (per consistent search-engine indexing) states the Building Division issues a building permit within 3 business days for over-the-counter applications or 5 business days for electronically filed applications, for small residential rooftop solar systems meeting the expedited-review checklist. Fullerton also incorporated SolarAPP+ per state law SB 379, which issues permits in real time for eligible systems — a separate, faster pathway not reflected in the min/max above since only the expedited-but-not-instant timeline was consistently described across sources.
